Discussed sphere, circle, and cuboid using familiar examples.
Ishita said a sphere has no edges and no flat side.
They identified a matchbox-shaped object as a cuboid and mentioned six faces.
They repeatedly requested 3D pictures or photos; these were not shown during the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised distinguishing a flat circle from a round sphere and connecting a matchbox-shaped object with a cuboid. They explained that a sphere has no edge or flat side, and later suggested that a cuboid may have six faces. There was no later correction needed, but the requested 3D visuals were not available in the lesson. At home, show a ball, a box, and a can, and ask Ishita to name each shape and describe its surfaces.
